# optimizelycmssaas_locale (Data Source)

Looks up an existing locale by key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "optimizelycmssaas_locale" "english" {
  key = "en"
}

output "english_route" {
  value = data.optimizelycmssaas_locale.english.route_segment
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key of the locale to look up.

### Read-Only

- `access_rights` (Attributes List) Who may create content in this locale. Empty means everyone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_rights))
- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the CMS.
- `fallback` (String) Locale key to fall back to when content is missing.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether content can be created in this locale. The CMS chooses a value when unset.
- `route_segment` (String) URL segment used when routing to this locale.
- `sort_order` (Number) Position when sorting locales. Assigned by the CMS when unset.

<a id="nestedatt--access_rights"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_rights`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the user, role or application.
- `type` (String) user, role or application. Defaults to role.
